# Replaces the runner image's /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt, which lists azure.archive.ubuntu.com first.
# It resolves to a mirror in the runner's Azure region, and the westus and westus3 mirrors relay packages
# from upstream at ~50 kB/s, which apt can take ~40 minutes to download, as it never fails over from a slow mirror:
# https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14823
https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/	priority:1
https://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/	priority:2
http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/	priority:3
